protocol.development_screen: Verified primary full-coverage Jan-Apr ledger: all months nonnegative, arithmetic mean at least10%, at least10completed actual trades. Diagnostic routes cannot rescue a failed primary. This screen does not replace original case acceptance.
protocol.acceptance: May/July/September full net capital month arithmetic mean at least10%; all May-September months nonnegative and full coverage. No month-specific fitting or extra future observation period gate. Exposed historical data remain development regression.
protocol.capital: Original settled-cash rule, allocation0/1 only; at most one ETF, no leverage, same-day reentry forbidden, T+1 and available dividend cash handled normally. V25 full-cash/dividend wait rule is not applied. All fees/slippage, dividends/splits, cross-month MTM and unknown-held occupation retained. Cash0 does not meet growth objective.

protocol.case_rule: No new May-Sep model/capital evaluation unless independently verified PRIMARY development passes. Data extension and exact development-prefix check required before cases. Existing history remains exposed development regression.
protocol.hypothesis: Four actual exit classes separating gap stops; signed cross-ETF shared multinomial probabilities and prequential log-score mixture with empirical class frequencies. Prior v12/v24 probability decompositions already failed; this is a new gap-class/shared-transfer/long-history/score-mixture hypothesis, not an untried generic probability idea.
protocol.inputs: Exact v77 long three-pair panels and six own-ETF raw labels (earlier labels plus exact frozen v75 all_labels). Price-only13 coordinates, same original18 full readiness. No new data, feature selection, price corrections or target-month access.
protocol.target_maturity: Unknown/incomplete full14day paired windows remain class-1. Train only matched three-pair chronological complete prefix available strictly before daily00ET; earlier positives are not released first. Actual same-bar stop-first and gaps retained. Gap class is risk_stop AND raw Open below contemporaneous cent-rounded protective stop.
protocol.directional_features: Original coordinate indices0,1,2,5,6,7,8,9,10 multiply by+1 long/-1 inverse side; price slots3,4,16,17 unchanged. Zero activity slots11..15 are omitted. The symmetry is a modeling assumption; ETF-specific offsets remain and all labels are actual own ETF returns.
protocol.base_model: Per clock, daily,>=120matched real dates. Six ETFs share13 standardized signed slopes, plus six ETF one-hot offsets; multinomial logits=log pooled class prior + design@theta. L2 objective penalty0.5*10*sum(theta^2), including offsets; no unpenalized intercept. Only globally observed classes active; absent class probability0, never fake a loss. Fully penalized convex adjustment around empirical prior.
protocol.weights: Date recency half-life126; normalize date weights to date ESS=(sum unnormalized)^2/sum squared. Divide each date weight equally among six ETF rows. Save real dates and ESS separately; clocks fitted separately, no claim of independent dates.
protocol.payoff_distribution: For each ETF, empirical joint class/payoff distribution gets20 effective-date units of pooled-six-ETF prior. Class prior=(own class mass+20*pooled class mass)/(ESS+20). Class log-payoff mean=(own class weighted logpayoff sum+20*pooled class payoff sum)/(own class mass+20*pooled class mass). Empty global classes get probability0 and placeholder mean0 that never carries mass. Conditional means are within observed class support; no additive residual return correction.
protocol.solver: Scipy L-BFGS-B analytic weighted softmax gradient,lambda10,zero start,maxiter2000,gtol1e-9,ftol1e-15,maxls50. Follow with at most5 exact-Hessian Newton refinements when gradient>1e-9; backtrack until objective increase within64 machine-epsilon relative units AND gradient infinity strictly decreases. Require finite gradient infinity <=1e-6 or fail run. Same strictly convex objective, no prediction/gate changes. Independent scalar-gradient/KKT and separate damped Newton anchor checks. Class ordering fixed.
protocol.mixture: Separate gap/merged histories. Daily latest120/min60 fully mature semiconductor dates with complete own as-issued raw and prior probabilities. Day score difference=mean across eligible clocks and both ETFs of log(max(raw trueclass probability,1e-8))-log(max(prior trueclass probability,1e-8)). Recency63 normalizedsumN. logodds=0.1*sum(date_weight*score_difference),alpha=sigmoid(logodds). p=alpha*raw+(1-alpha)*prior. Equal prior expert weights;0.1 is fixed tempering for dependent overlapping windows,not a proven effective sample correction. No retrospective model predictions used. None of these mixture weights guarantees probability calibration.
protocol.decision: PRIMARY gap_blend chooses ETF with greatest expected contract net log return sum(probability*class payoff mean)>1e-12,tieSOXL; otherwiseCASH. No additive residual correction or bootstrap radius. All new score controls retain same>=60feedback readiness and unresolved-expired prefix gates; controls cannot rescue primary. No threshold grid or month identifiers.
